questions.en: Is there a garbage collection truck, or a worker emptying a bin into a truck?
Is a person touching or handling an object with their hands?
Is at least one person visible in the frames?
Is a person standing close to waste without touching it?
In the first frames (top row), is a person holding a bag or an object?
In the last frames (bottom row), is a person holding a bag or an object?
In the first frames (top row), is there a bag or an object on the ground?
In the last frames (bottom row), is there a bag or an object on the ground with nobody touching it?

derived_features._note: Per-grid combinations of the four direction questions (logit level). dep_state>0: holding at the start and on the ground at the end (deposit); pick_state = -dep_state (pick-up).
